RL_Bandits.name: Doubly Robust Off-Policy Evaluation for threshold tuning
RL_Bandits.from_paper: Dudik, Langford & Li 2011 'Doubly Robust Policy Evaluation'
RL_Bandits.analogy: logged data = 1.77M samples; π_β = oracle action; π = our policy; DR = direct method + IPS correction → variance ↓
RL_Bandits.novelty: extends T62 unbiased thresh with direct-method baseline

RL_Bandits.name: Conservative Q-Learning (offline RL, value-based)
RL_Bandits.from_paper: Kumar et al. 2020 'Conservative Q-Learning for Offline RL'
RL_Bandits.analogy: state = current 100×154 window; action = {SELL,ABSTAIN,BUY}; R = official PnL; CQL penalty pushes down OOD action Q
RL_Bandits.redline_compat: state purely in-batch, no sym embedding, no date
RL_Bandits.novelty: T60 was policy-gradient PnL loss; CQL is value-based with conservatism penalty → different inductive bias

CV_OOD.name: Mahalanobis distance OOD score for selective gating
CV_OOD.from_paper: Lee et al. 2018 'A Simple Unified Framework for Detecting OOD Samples'
CV_OOD.analogy: 5 sym = 5 in-distribution Gaussians; held-out sym → high M(x) → abstain at inference
CV_OOD.redline_compat: uses train-time stats only; no sym ID at inference
CV_OOD.novelty: T82/T83 are score-domain robust thresh; Mahalanobis is input-feature-domain OOD

CV_OOD.name: CORAL second-order moment matching across syms
CV_OOD.redline_compat: sym used only at train time as auxiliary signal
CV_OOD.novelty: T45 GroupDRO was worst-case risk; CORAL is distribution-matching

NLP_SSL.name: Cross-sym contrastive pretraining (SimCSE/SimCLR)
NLP_SSL.from_paper: Chen et al. 2020 SimCLR / Gao et al. 2021 SimCSE
NLP_SSL.analogy: augmentation (time jitter, dropout, vol scaling, cross-sym mix) → InfoNCE → sym-invariant 128-D representation, fed to GBDT
NLP_SSL.novelty: T44 hand-crafted features; this is learned representation

NLP_SSL.name: Masked LOB Modeling (BERT-style timestep masking)
NLP_SSL.analogy: random mask 15% timesteps in window, predict from context; learn token-level (per-tick) representation
NLP_SSL.novelty: no MLM-style SSL tried in 80 experiments

NLP_SSL.name: Curriculum learning by horizon difficulty (h60→h5)
NLP_SSL.analogy: h=60 high SNR (easy) → h=5 low SNR (hard); LightGBM init_model carries earlier knowledge
NLP_SSL.novelty: T12 multi-horizon stacking is post-hoc; this is train-time transfer

Robotics_S2R.name: Domain Randomization (physics-parameter)
Robotics_S2R.analogy: ISOMORPHIC TO T26 — already implemented as feature-gain randomization; only marginal extension via session-level vol/spread randomization

Robotics_S2R.name: RL² / System Identification via in-window latent
Robotics_S2R.from_paper: Gupta et al. 2018 / Duan et al. RL² 2016
Robotics_S2R.analogy: infer 'regime z' from current 100-tick window only; condition GBDT on z
Robotics_S2R.redline_compat: z derived from current window only — no cross-batch state

Bio_Small_N.name: Prototypical mixture of experts via cluster routing
Bio_Small_N.analogy: K=10 cluster prototypes in encoded feature space (NOT sym ID); soft attention routes window to expert mixture
Bio_Small_N.redline_compat: uses learned cluster, not sym ID; T48 violated, this fixes it

Bio_Small_N.name: Strong architectural prior — bid-ask symmetric DeepLOB
Bio_Small_N.from_paper: Zhang et al. 2019 DeepLOB; informed by AlphaFold-style equivariance
Bio_Small_N.analogy: shared-weight conv on bid-stack vs ask-stack with sign flip → encodes mid-symmetry
Bio_Small_N.novelty: T93/T94/T95/T97 used standard arch; bid-ask symmetry constraint not used

Econometrics.name: GARCH per-window vol-aware threshold
Econometrics.analogy: fit ARMA-GARCH on window's midprice returns → σ̂_{t+h} → threshold scales as k·σ̂
Econometrics.novelty: T76/T82/T83 are score-domain; this is input-domain vol-aware gate

Econometrics.name: Bootstrap CI selective trading via std-as-gate
Econometrics.analogy: 20 bootstrap GBDT → (μ̂, σ̂_bootstrap); trade only if |μ̂| > 2·σ̂
Econometrics.novelty: T11/T17/T46 use ensemble mean; this uses ensemble disagreement as gate

Med_Decision.name: Selective Prediction with Abstain (SelectiveNet)
Med_Decision.analogy: label=1 (FLAT) IS the abstain action; train (binary classifier g, selector h) jointly with coverage constraint c
Med_Decision.novelty: PARADIGM SHIFT — all 80 experiments treated abstain as post-hoc threshold; SelectiveNet trains it jointly

Med_Decision.name: Deep ensembles + predictive entropy as gate
Med_Decision.analogy: M independent models → mean predictive distribution → entropy H; trade only if H < τ_H
Med_Decision.novelty: ensembles already in T11/T17/T46 but used as mean; entropy-as-gate is new angle

Info_Theory.name: Information Bottleneck via gradient reversal (DANN)
Info_Theory.analogy: minimax: min_φ,h max_d [CE(h(φ(x)),y) - λ·CE(d(φ(x)),sym)] → φ encodes y info but no sym info
Info_Theory.redline_compat: sym only used as auxiliary at train time; inference no sym
Info_Theory.novelty: T45 GroupDRO was worst-case; DANN is invariance-penalty — alternative untried

Info_Theory.name: VAE representation + GBDT downstream
Info_Theory.analogy: compress 100×154 to 64-D z via β-VAE; concat z to GBDT

Info_Theory.name: MDL feature selection
Info_Theory.analogy: noise feature has DL > predictive gain → drop; LightGBM L1 + monotonic constraint approximates MDL
Info_Theory.novelty: T85 is leakage audit; MDL is statistical model selection — complementary

top5_cross_domain.name: Selective Prediction with Abstain (SelectiveNet)
top5_cross_domain.rationale: abstain = first-class action, perfect mapping; 80 experiments missed this paradigm shift

top5_cross_domain.name: Information Bottleneck via DANN/GRL
top5_cross_domain.rationale: directly attacks sym-OOD redline ③ which is the central data challenge

top5_cross_domain.name: Conservative Q-Learning (CQL)
top5_cross_domain.rationale: offline RL is the natural framework; T60 was policy-gradient, CQL is value-based — orthogonal angle

top5_cross_domain.name: Cross-Sym Contrastive Pretraining (SimCSE)
top5_cross_domain.from_paper: Gao et al. 2021 / Chen et al. 2020
top5_cross_domain.rationale: leverages all 1.77M unlabeled windows including held-out sym; learned representation upper bound > handcrafted

top5_cross_domain.name: Mahalanobis OOD Score for Selective Gating
top5_cross_domain.rationale: simple, principled OOD detection; integrates orthogonally with existing GBDT pipeline

stages: Stage 1: SimCSE encoder φ pretrain (#4) on all 1.77M windows
Stage 2: SelectiveNet (g,h) (#1) trained on 226 handcrafted + 128 from φ, with IB-DANN auxiliary loss (#2)
Stage 3: At inference, gate via Mahalanobis OOD (#5) on encoded z + Bootstrap CI gate (#6.2)
Stage 4: ABSTAIN if any gate fails, else argmax(g)

redline_compliance_summary.redline_2_stateless: all 13 ideas compliant — encoders consume only current window; train-time stats stored as constants
redline_compliance_summary.redline_3_sym_agnostic: all 13 ideas compliant — sym used only as train-time auxiliary signal; inference never reads sym ID; OOD detection / cluster routing replace sym-conditional logic

notes: 13 ideas covering all 8 domains. 8 fully novel vs T1-T98, 4 with new orthogonal angle, 1 marked isomorphic (T26 ≡ DR). Top 5 are all in fully-novel set. Central insight: 80+ prior experiments stayed on 'how to train GBDT better' axis; the missing reframe is 'abstain as first-class action' which medical imaging / selective classification literature already solves.
